_readme: Decision readiness. One row per requirement in the brief, grouped by the layer it belongs to. 'status' is decided from the file named in computed_from plus the re-verification done in this session, never from a claim in prose. 'clears_when' is the number a reader can check. Thresholds that nobody has set are published as 'decision not made' rather than filled with a plausible number.
generated_by: tools/desk/emit_data.py + hand classification of the brief (session ed736fc3-nfl1)

legend.met: the artefact exists and the number that would clear the gate is reached
legend.partial: part of the evidence exists; the gate is not reached
legend.blocked: the gate is not reached and no source in the repo can close it
legend.not_started: no artefact in the repo answers the requirement
legend.decision_needed: the requirement is a choice a human must make before any work can clear it

rows.requirement: Price-snapshot store recording opening and closing numbers for every market originated
rows.blocking_gate: no approved price source with a fetch clock
rows.number_now: 1 value per market per game; 0 opening/closing pairs; 0 fetch timestamps
rows.clears_when: 100% of originated markets carry an opening row, a closing row and the time each was read
rows.source_label: repo artefact (third-party prices, not an official NFL source)
rows.action: choose the price source and its polling cadence, then store two rows per market

rows.requirement: Verified results feed so backtests and ROI can be computed at all
rows.blocking_gate: corpus lag against the official schedule
rows.number_now: 137 completed games in the corpus vs 149 implied by the official standings; 12 of 13 Week-10 finals missing
rows.clears_when: corpus completed-game count equals the official standings implication on the same day
rows.action: re-run the collector in Actions (it cannot reach nflverse from this sandbox) or extend the frozen corpus with a new corpus_id

rows.requirement: Originate the side first, then the total, then the moneyline
rows.blocking_gate: moneyline market not originated
rows.number_now: 13 side lines and 13 total lines originated for Week 11; 0 moneyline prices produced
rows.clears_when: 13 of 13 Week-11 fixtures carry a home and away moneyline from the model
rows.action: derive the moneyline from the win-probability output already stored, and publish it beside side and total

rows.requirement: Publish the model's fair line, the market line and the difference as separate columns
rows.blocking_gate: none — the three columns exist
rows.number_now: 13 of 13 rows carry my_home_line, market_home_line and edge_home_line computed from the printed values
rows.clears_when: already cleared
rows.action: none

rows.requirement: A two-sided 'what would change our mind' field on every strategy entry
rows.blocking_gate: none
rows.number_now: 12 claims, each with a confirming and an abandoning observation and a frozen threshold
rows.clears_when: already cleared
rows.action: none

rows.requirement: Price a line ourselves and publish the residual against the market, on a schedule, from day one
rows.blocking_gate: no schedule; one build, not a dated series
rows.number_now: 13 residuals published once; 1 build timestamp
rows.clears_when: a dated residual row per fixture per day, so the line can be compared to where the market moved
rows.action: write the residual each time the collector runs, keyed by fixture and fetch time

rows.requirement: Vig-free market consensus vs originated fair-line decomposition
rows.blocking_gate: no two-sided price pairs to de-vig
rows.number_now: point spreads and totals only; 0 paired prices
rows.clears_when: both sides of a market are stored so the hold can be removed arithmetically
rows.action: depends on P-01

rows.requirement: Separate signal from staking on the leaderboard
rows.blocking_gate: none
rows.number_now: 12 strategies scored on Brier skill and on realised ROI as separate columns, so a staking run cannot mask a weak signal
rows.clears_when: already cleared
rows.action: none

rows.requirement: Rank with proper scores and uncertainty, not win rate
rows.blocking_gate: none
rows.number_now: Brier skill with a game-cluster bootstrap interval (2000 resamples) and a Benjamini-Hochberg charge over 6 tests
rows.clears_when: already cleared
rows.action: none

rows.requirement: Compute and publish the removal-of-luck panel
rows.blocking_gate: none
rows.number_now: 12 strategies with a null distribution, a 95% luck band and the sample needed for 80% power
rows.clears_when: already cleared
rows.action: none

rows.requirement: Pre-register every strategy; forbid backtest numbers from ever appearing on the leaderboard
rows.blocking_gate: 12 backtest rows still ranked on the s9cb leaderboard
rows.number_now: 31 registered (12 backtest, 19 prospective); 12 backtest rows still published with ROI
rows.clears_when: 0 backtest rows on any leaderboard; only prospective, settled rows ranked
rows.action: relabel the s9cb board as an archive and rank only the prospective board

rows.requirement: Define a demotion gate that sends a live strategy back to paper
rows.blocking_gate: none — the gate is armed
rows.number_now: 3 demotion tests, 31 strategies on paper, 0 live, 0 demotions ever
rows.clears_when: already cleared (the gate exists; nothing is live to demote)
rows.action: none

rows.requirement: Use proper-score leaderboard divisions (singles, game parlays, same-game parlays, prop combos)
rows.blocking_gate: no priced same-game-parlay or prop-combo market
rows.number_now: 12 singles strategies scored; 0 parlay or combo rows scored
rows.clears_when: a division exists for each of the four bet types and each has at least one scored strategy
rows.action: keeps parlays behind the joint-evidence gate until a joint probability is validated

rows.requirement: Keep parlays and prop combos behind a joint-evidence gate
rows.blocking_gate: none — the gate is in force
rows.number_now: 0 of the pairs survive the family-wise threshold; the page says so instead of ranking them
rows.clears_when: already cleared
rows.action: none

rows.requirement: Add a control baseline (random picks, favourites only) to every leaderboard run
rows.blocking_gate: none
rows.number_now: the closing-line benchmark and the coin benchmark are scored in the same run as every strategy
rows.clears_when: already cleared
rows.action: none

rows.requirement: Compute correlations only from officially sourced numbers, with n on every value
rows.blocking_gate: the price inputs are third-party, not official
rows.number_now: 6 game-level relationships, each with n and a Fisher-z interval; n = 6976 for the priced ones
rows.clears_when: the same values computed from a store whose every input carries an official source
rows.action: mark which column of each relationship is official; blank the ones that are not

rows.requirement: Turn the 136-game log into the pre-registered backtest corpus
rows.blocking_gate: the frozen corpus is older than the official schedule
rows.number_now: 7239 rows frozen; 137 completed 2026 games; official standings imply 149
rows.clears_when: a new corpus_id frozen over the complete season with its own member counts
rows.action: freeze corpus v2 after the collector runs; never edit v1

rows.requirement: Split data into train, validation and final holdout seasons
rows.blocking_gate: none
rows.number_now: train 6151, validation 544, holdout 409, holdout unopened
rows.clears_when: already cleared
rows.action: none

rows.requirement: Add injury and personnel ablations instead of fixed penalties
rows.blocking_gate: no two models differing only in the personnel features
rows.number_now: a fixed replacement penalty is applied; 0 ablation runs published
rows.clears_when: two identical fits, with and without availability, reported as a paired difference with an interval on a chronological holdout
rows.action: needs an availability series that predates each kickoff (see A-03)

rows.requirement: Score injury-designation reliability before using it as a feature
rows.blocking_gate: no inactive lists and no per-designation play rates
rows.number_now: 0 play-rate estimates; 20 Week-9 inactive rows in the whole repo
rows.clears_when: a play rate with an interval for Out / Doubtful / Questionable across several seasons
rows.action: requires the inactive lists the brief asks for

rows.requirement: Automate immutable multi-day availability snapshots with retained hashes
rows.blocking_gate: one capture, one day
rows.number_now: 1 capture (2026-11-15T12:16Z, 347 rows) and a heartbeat log; cadence is every 6 hours
rows.clears_when: a capture per report day (Wed, Thu, Fri) for at least two consecutive weeks, each with a hash of the raw body
rows.action: let the scheduled workflow run; it only stretches the series when it runs on the report days

rows.requirement: Treat the injury report as a timestamped series and publish the delta, never the level
rows.blocking_gate: only two dated reads exist to difference
rows.number_now: 1 published delta between 2026-11-14 and 2026-11-15
rows.clears_when: a delta row per report day with the clock time of each read
rows.action: same workflow as A-01

rows.requirement: Point-in-time snapshot ledger to prevent lookahead leakage
rows.blocking_gate: no pre-kickoff capture for more than one game week
rows.number_now: 1 capture; 0 fixtures with a capture taken before their kickoff and after their final practice
rows.clears_when: every backtested fixture has an availability read whose clock time precedes its kickoff
rows.action: capture cadence, then join by kickoff time

rows.requirement: Capture official inactive lists and snap counts
rows.blocking_gate: no official inactive list or snap-count feed in the repo
rows.number_now: 20 inactive rows (8 emergency quarterbacks) from one week; 0 snap-count sources
rows.clears_when: official inactives for every played fixture, plus a snap-count source, so a replacement can be confirmed rather than suspected
rows.action: needs an official source; the club game books the brief names are the candidate

rows.requirement: Model depth from playing time, not jersey order
rows.blocking_gate: no official snap-count source, and no per-club chart for all 32 clubs
rows.number_now: 238 register rows across 4 clubs; 28 clubs unread; 0 snap-count rows
rows.clears_when: a snap-count column for every charted player, or a verified chart for all 32 clubs
rows.action: decide the route (club charts vs snap counts) before building the deficiency feature

rows.requirement: Build the availability graph as a first-class dataset (expected starter vs actual)
rows.blocking_gate: actual starters require the official Game Book, which is not in the repo
rows.number_now: 5 named replacement chains resolved from club charts for 3 clubs, each marked UNCONFIRMED (chart evidence only); 0 confirmed starters
rows.clears_when: every played fixture has an official starter for both units of both clubs
rows.action: ingest official game books

rows.requirement: Run the 32-team roster/IR sweep before any team-level model is trusted
rows.blocking_gate: the register prints 25 rows per category-month and no deeper window
rows.number_now: 448 captured register rows; 100 open reserve designations; 83 named players with no injury-report row
rows.clears_when: a 32-club roster and IR state reconciled against an official roster publication with no capped month
rows.action: union over time closes the running month; closed months are permanently short and must be disclosed

rows.requirement: Make the injury signal a surprise, never a level
rows.blocking_gate: no expectation model to take a surprise against
rows.number_now: 0 surprise values; the availability layer reports counts, not deviations from expectation
rows.clears_when: each designation is published as observed minus expected with the expectation stated
rows.action: needs A-03 and S-13 first

rows.requirement: Flag stale depth rows against the official transactions log
rows.blocking_gate: the check compares names, not ranks
rows.number_now: 29 findings (12 current-claim, 17 superseded) across 12 clubs, 663 names compared; this session resolved the Baltimore case at source (Brissett now QB1)
rows.clears_when: every chart's rank-1 name reconciled with the dated register, with 0 unexplained findings
rows.action: rerun after the next chart refresh

rows.requirement: An announced-starter evidence field (not an inferred replacement)
rows.blocking_gate: no field distinguishes 'announced' from 'next name on the chart'
rows.number_now: 5 chains, each carrying the report row that makes the starter Out and the chart that names the next man — labelled CHART EVIDENCE, not announcement
rows.clears_when: a dated club or league announcement is attached to each replacement
rows.action: add an announcement field and leave it blank until a source exists

rows.requirement: Fix the two depth-parsing failures (Texans image, Packers jersey prefixes)
rows.blocking_gate: the Texans publish depth as an image
rows.number_now: Packers: 54 named cells parsed with the jersey number preserved in raw and stripped in name (re-read this session); Texans: 0 rows recoverable
rows.clears_when: both clubs parsed, or the Texans row explicitly published as image-only with a structured source named
rows.action: publish the Texans gap; do not transcribe by eye

rows.requirement: Model depth slots as groups, not a single starter
rows.blocking_gate: the repo has no slot-level group count published
rows.number_now: this session's three charts hold slots with 2-4 names in one cell (e.g. DET CB, GB RB); the published pages treat rank 1 as the starter
rows.clears_when: every page prints a slot's full group and no page calls a single rank-1 name 'the starter'
rows.action: render groups; the data already carries them

rows.requirement: Treat roster turnover as a first-class data event
rows.blocking_gate: the register's 25-row cap
rows.number_now: 448 dated rows; 15 of 24 category-months capped on 2026-11-16
rows.clears_when: depth and availability evidence versioned against the last official roster event, with no capped month behind a published claim
rows.action: version each chart capture against the newest register row it could have seen

rows.requirement: Capture the reserve list so 'not listed' never means 'available'
rows.blocking_gate: none — the join is published
rows.number_now: 100 open reserve designations; 83 named on a reserve list and on no report row; 17 on both
rows.clears_when: already cleared
rows.action: none

rows.requirement: Calibrate what 'Questionable' means empirically
rows.blocking_gate: no inactive lists to join designations to
rows.number_now: 90 Questionable rows in Week 10; 0 play rates
rows.clears_when: a play rate per designation with an interval, over several seasons
rows.action: archive old reports and join inactives

rows.requirement: Interactive offense vs defence deficiency matrix (1st-4th string)
rows.blocking_gate: 3 of 32 charts read; no snap-backed depth order
rows.number_now: 3 clubs transcribed; 0 matchup cells
rows.clears_when: 32 charts or snap-count depth, plus a confirmed availability read per club
rows.action: coverage first; the matrix is a rendering of data that does not exist yet

rows.requirement: Represent shared and empty depth slots faithfully
rows.blocking_gate: the register models a slot as one name
rows.number_now: 2 empty slots (BAL K, GB PR) and multiple multi-name cells preserved in this session's transcription
rows.clears_when: the register stores a list per slot and the pages render the list
rows.action: schema change in the register, which another generator owns

rows.requirement: Publish a weekly 'what changed' diff instead of a static snapshot
rows.blocking_gate: 1 snapshot, so there is nothing to difference
rows.number_now: 0 published diffs; has_previous = false
rows.clears_when: 2 snapshots exist and the diff column is rendered with rank, rating and availability change
rows.action: a second build after a week of data will create the first real diff

rows.requirement: Store every injury-hub read with its clock time and publish the delta
rows.blocking_gate: 3 heartbeat rows, 1 distinct report
rows.number_now: 3 reads logged; 1 distinct parsed report
rows.clears_when: a read per day with a clock time, and a delta published between consecutive reads
rows.action: same workflow as A-01

rows.requirement: Add a fixture-context feature set built only from published schedule facts
rows.blocking_gate: the context columns are third-party, not official
rows.number_now: rest days, roof, surface and referee columns exist; 13 Week-11 fixtures re-verified against the official schedule this session
rows.clears_when: every context column traces to a published official page
rows.action: classify each column as official or third-party on the page

rows.requirement: Store every model output as a probability plus its inputs
rows.blocking_gate: props store projections without a probability
rows.number_now: 13 side/total rows carry a win probability and the ratings that produced it; 323 prop lines carry 0 probabilities
rows.clears_when: every stored output has a probability and the inputs that produced it
rows.action: add a probability to the prop rows, or stop calling them outputs

rows.requirement: Decide the price-data policy before any backtest is published
rows.blocking_gate: price_policy.state = 'open decision'
rows.number_now: 1 corpus frozen with the policy marked open; the -110 assumption is retired for future runs
rows.clears_when: a written policy naming the source, the snapshot time and the treatment of a missing price
rows.action: owner decision; blocks P-01 and every priced backtest

rows.requirement: Freeze a rule before it sees data (pre-registration)
rows.blocking_gate: none
rows.number_now: 31 records; registration commit recorded with the file hash; the ancestry check is a build gate
rows.clears_when: already cleared
rows.action: none

rows.requirement: Add a drift alarm to every scraper
rows.blocking_gate: some scrapers still have no row-count pin
rows.number_now: row-count pins exist for the depth register and 24 transaction pages; the injury scraper's pin coverage is partial
rows.clears_when: every scraper fails the build on a missing field or a row count outside its pin
rows.action: extend the pin table to the injury scraper

rows.requirement: Split the site into a public analysis layer and a private data layer
rows.blocking_gate: terms of use not read by the owner
rows.number_now: the terms record exists with the policy stated; row-level data is still published in the repo
rows.clears_when: row-level data held privately and only derived analysis published, per a read of the terms
rows.action: owner decision after reading the terms

rows.requirement: Use official Game Books for actual starters and game-day status; do not infer depth
rows.blocking_gate: no Game Book ingest
rows.number_now: 0 Game Book rows
rows.clears_when: a Game Book row per played fixture with its starter list
rows.source_label: nfl.com game pages (game book links live on the game page)
rows.action: ingest; this is the only route to a confirmed starter

rows.requirement: Ingest game-level results to make the ratings opponent-aware
rows.blocking_gate: corpus lag
rows.number_now: ratings carry n_off and n_def per club (about 1300 plays each) but only 137 completed 2026 games
rows.clears_when: the corpus holds every completed game on the day the ratings are published
rows.action: same as P-02

rows.requirement: Archive weekly injury reports for past seasons
rows.blocking_gate: no historical archive in the repo
rows.number_now: 1 capture, current season, current week
rows.clears_when: a dated capture for each report day of at least one complete season
rows.action: the page exposes past seasons in its selector; the capture job must walk them

rows.requirement: Transcribe the venue of every fixture from the official game centre
rows.blocking_gate: venue is not printed as a field on the week page; it appears in the hotel link query
rows.number_now: 13 Week-11 fixtures with a venue note derived from the official page's own stadium link text
rows.clears_when: a venue field read from each game centre page rather than from a link
rows.action: read the game centre page per fixture

rows.requirement: Stadium roof/surface register and hourly wind/precipitation overlay
rows.blocking_gate: roof and surface columns are third-party; no weather overlay
rows.number_now: roof and surface columns exist for history; 0 official roof designations; 0 weather rows
rows.clears_when: a roof/surface value with an official source per stadium, plus an hourly forecast at kickoff
rows.source_label: nfl.com prints a short weather note on the week page, not an hourly grid
rows.action: needs a weather source and an official stadium register

rows.requirement: 2026 kickoff and declared onside-kick regime priors
rows.blocking_gate: no regime prior in the model
rows.number_now: 0 regime adjustments; the model does not condition on the 2026 kickoff rule
rows.clears_when: the prior is stated, frozen and shown to move the total estimate on a holdout
rows.action: state the prior first; it needs the official rule text as its source

rows.requirement: Publish every model total twice until one wins
rows.blocking_gate: none — no winner yet, and the page says so
rows.number_now: two estimators on 6109 games; holdout paired difference -0.014 (95% CI -0.229 to 0.219) — not separated
rows.clears_when: already cleared (both are published with the gap column)
rows.action: none

rows.requirement: Make suggestions reviewable and choosable before implementation
rows.blocking_gate: no recorded owner choice
rows.number_now: 34 suggestions and 12 registered hypotheses; 0 decisions signed off
rows.clears_when: each suggestion carries a chosen path and a date
rows.action: owner picks a path; this page is the menu

rows.requirement: Publish a decision-readiness table on the landing page
rows.blocking_gate: none — this is that table
rows.number_now: 52 requirement rows, each with the blocking gate, the number now and the number that clears it
rows.clears_when: already cleared
